messages:
Maria: Quick sync — I'm onboarding comet-13b-q into the catalog. Need a quick double-check on weights location + tokenizer quirk before we run latency/throughput sweeps tomorrow.

Maria: Weights reference: s3://redwood-models/comet/13b/q4_0/comet-13b-q.safetensors
Maria: sha256: 3a8f9f2c4b7d9e6f2a5c4d1e8b9f0a1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7 (pushed from model-team). Only .safetensors present, no pytorch bin.

Kevin: I'll verify the S3 path and checksum in a minute.

Raj: Heads-up: tokenizer.json for this model uses a 3-byte BOS token ("<|bos|>") which breaks our prefix cache if not normalized. Need serving config flag: tokenizer.vocab_fix = true

Maria: ah ok that's the quirk I mentioned. Good catch.

Kevin: quick check done — file exists in comet/13b/q4_0/, size 7.1GB. checksum matches the one Maria posted.
Kevin: also confirmed model config: hidden_size 8192, rotary 32, vocab_size 50288.

Sophia: For perf runs, propose: batch sizes [1,2,4,8,16], seq_len 128, concurrency 8. Use --max-batch-tokens 4096 and 10 warmup + 200 samples. That should surface latency p95 and throughput crossover.

Maria: sounds good. Target p95 < 220ms for single-token stepping at batch 4 (our hosted SLO reference). If not, we'll try q2_K or fallback to 8-bit kernel.

Raj: here's the serving config snippet I'll add to the catalog entry (paste):
```
serving:
  model_path: s3://redwood-models/comet/13b/q4_0/
  weights_file: comet-13b-q.safetensors
  tokenizer:
    file: tokenizer.json
    vocab_fix: true
  runtime:
    max_batch_tokens: 4096
    kv_cache_policy: prefix-aware
```

Kevin: ran a quick smoke on dev-gpu-1 (single GPU, a100-40gb): model loads, init errors: none. memory stable ~23.4GB, peak ~26GB during first forward.

Kevin: small log note: one warning about "unknown special token" at load time — looks related to the 3-byte BOS, but it's non-fatal.

perf-bot: scheduled perf job comet-13b-q-latency-214930 at 2149303600, cluster=perf-slice-3, runners=4

Sophia: when you run the perf-bot job, please include both latency histogram and token-level breakdown. Also capture tail latency per replica.

Maria: can someone kick off a matrix run: batch x seq_len x concurrency? If perf-bot can only do a single config, I'll run the matrix locally and upload results to the perf bucket.

Kevin: I'll start the matrix on perf-slice-3 now. using command:
```
./perf-run --model comet-13b-q --weights s3://redwood-models/comet/13b/q4_0/ --batches 1,2,4,8,16 --seq 64,128 --concurrency 2,4,8 --warmup 10 --iters 200 --tag comet-13b-q-matrix-214930
```

Maria: sweet. please annotate if any batch size causes kv-cache misses (that would imply tokenizer normalization not applied).

Raj: I'll open a tiny PR to add tokenizer.vocab_fix to the catalog schema and reference this thread for the rationale.

Sophia: one more note — if p95 is close but throughput is too low, try enabling split-kernel path for attention (we saw ~12% speedup on similar configs).

Kevin: first pass results (partial): batch 1 p95=180ms, batch 2 p95=145ms, batch 4 p95=210ms, batch 8 p95=380ms (throughput increases but tail spikes). seq128/concurrency8 showing CPU spikes on preproc.

Maria: ok that's within expectations for batch4 but p95 210ms leaves less room. keep full runs going and upload CSVs to s3://redwood-perf/comet/13b/q4_0/

Kevin: uploaded partial CSVs: s3://redwood-perf/comet/13b/q4_0/comet-214930-partial.csv

Maria: thanks. next steps: Raj PR for config, Sophia to try split-kernel toggle in next run, Kevin to finish full matrix, I'll update catalog draft with tokenizer note and perf summary.

Sophia: ack, I'll queue split-kernel run after Kevin's full results are in. :thumbsup: 

Raj: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/catalog/pull/498 — adds tokenizer.vocab_fix with tests. linking this thread.

Maria: perfect. Closing loop — we'll target final perf report and catalog merge by EOD tomorrow. ping here with final run_id.

infra-bot: reminder — please tag infra-ticket if you need Dedicated capacity for sustained perf runs: #ticket-8032

Kevin: noted, will open ticket if we need > 8h runtime.

Maria: thanks everyone :rocket:
